versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support variants of configured BSW data resolved after system start - up Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall define which configurable BSW data items are allowed to be configured as multiple variants and be resolved after system start - up Rationale: Resolving variants of the configurable BSW data items after the system start up allows using the same ECU for different needs in one car version which reduces cost Use Case: Adapt ECUs to specific needs in one car version, e.g. left door vs. right door ECU Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
